text.body:
śrīpadmapurāṇam
sṛṣṭikhaṇḍam
prathamo'dhyāyaḥ
śrīviṣṇave namaḥ
svacchaṃcaṃdrā vadātaṃkarikaramakarakṣobhasaṃjātaphenaṃ brahmodbhūtiprasaktairvrataniyamaparaiḥ sevitaṃvipramukhyaiḥ kārālaṃkṛtenatribhuvanaguruṇābrahmaṇādṛṣṭipūtaṃ saṃbhogābhogaramyaṃjalamaśubhaharaṃpauṣkaraṃ vaḥpunātu 1 sūtamekāṃtamāsīnaṃvyāsaśiṣyaṃmahāmatiḥ lomaharṣaṇanāmāvāugraśravasamāhatat 2 ṛṣīṇāmāśramāṃstātagatvādharmānsamāsataḥ pṛcchatāṃvistarādbrūhiyanmattaḥśrutavānasi 3 vedavyāsānmayāputrapurāṇānyakhilānica tavākhyātāniprāptānimunibhyovadavistarāt 4 prayāgemunivaryaiścayathāpṛṣṭaḥsvayaṃprabhuḥ pṛṣṭenacānuśiṣṭāstemunayodharmakāṃkṣiṇaḥ 5 deśaṃpuṇyamabhīpsaṃtovibhunācahitaiṣiṇā sunābhaṃdivyarūpaṃcasatyagaṃśubhavikramaṃ 6 anaupamyamidaṃcakraṃvartamānamataṃdri tāḥ pṛṣṭatoyātaniyamātpadaṃprāpsyathayaddhitam 7 gacchatodharmacakrasyayatranemirviśīryate puṇyaḥsadeśomaṃtavyaityuvācasvayaṃprabhuḥ 8 uktvācaivamṛṣīnsarvānadṛśyatvamagātpunaḥ gaṃgāvartasamāhāronemiryatravyaśīryata 9 ījiredīrghasatreṇaṛṣayonaimiṣetadā tatragatvātutānbrūhipṛcchatodharmasaṃśayān 10 ugraśravāstatogatvājñānavinmunipuṃgavān abhigamyopasaṃgṛhyanamaskṛtvākṛtāṃjali 11 toṣayāmāsamedhāvīpraṇipātenatānṛṣīn tecāpisatriṇaḥprītāḥsasadasyāmahātmane 12 tasmaisametyapūjāṃcayathāvatpratipedire ṛṣayaūcuḥ kutastvamāgataḥsūtakasmāddeśādihāgataḥ 13 kāraṇaṃcāgamebrūhivṛṃdārakasamadyute sūtauvāca pitrāhaṃtusamādiṣṭovyāsaśiṣyeṇadhīmatā 14 śuśrūṣasvamunīngatvāyattepṛcchaṃtitadvada vadaṃtubhagavaṃtomāṃkathayāmikathāṃtuyāṃ 15 purāṇaṃcetihāsaṃvādharmānathapṛthagvidhān tāṃgiraṃmadhurāṃtasyaśuśruvurṛṣisattamāḥ 16 athateṣāṃpurāṇasyaśuśrūṣāsamapadyata dṛṣṭvātamativiśvastaṃvidvāṃsaṃlaumaharṣaṇiṃ 17 tasminsatrekulapatissarvaśāstrāviśāradaḥ śaunakonāmamedhāvīvijñānāraṇyakeguruḥ 18 itthaṃtadbhāvamālaṃbyadharmāñchuśrūṣurāhatam tvayāsūtamahābuddhebhagavānbrahmavittamaḥ 19 itihāsapurāṇārthaṃvyāsaḥsamyagupāsitaḥ dudohithamatiṃtasyatvaṃpurāṇāśrayāṃśubhāṃ 20 amīṣāṃvipramukhyānāṃpurāṇaṃpratisamprati śuśrūṣā'stemahābuddhetachrāvayitumarhasi 21 sarvehīmemahātmānonānāgotrāḥsamāgatāḥ svānsvānaṃśānpurāṇoktāñchṛṇvantubrahmavādinaḥ 22 saṃpūrṇedīrghasatresmiṃstāṃstvaṃśrāvayavaimunīn pādmaṃpurāṇaṃsarveṣāṃkathayasvamahāmate 23 kathaṃpadmaṃsamudbhūtaṃbrahmatatrakathaṃnvabhūt prodbhūtenakathaṃsṛṣṭiḥkṛtātāṃtutathāvada 24 evaṃpṛṣṭastatastāṃstupratyuvācaśubhāṃgiram sūkṣmaṃcanyāyasaṃyuktaṃprābravīdrau maharṣaṇiḥ 25 prītosmyanugṛhītosmibhavadbhirihacodanāt purāṇārthaṃpurāṇajñaiḥsarvadharmaparāyaṇaiḥ 26 yathāśrutaṃsuvikhyātaṃtatsarvaṃkathayāmivaḥ dharmaeṣatusūtasyasadbhirdṛṣṭaḥ sanātanaḥ 27 devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃcarājñāṃcāmitatejasām vaṃśānāṃdhāraṇaṃkāryaṃstutīnāṃcamahātmanām 28 itihāsapurāṇeṣudṛṣṭāyebrahmavādinaḥ nahivedeṣvadhīkāraḥ kaścitsūtasyadṛśyate 29 vainyasyahipṛthoryajñevarttamānemahātmanaḥ māgadhaścaivasūtaścatamastautāṃnareśvaram 30 tuṣṭenāthatayorddattovarorājñāmahātmanā sūtāyasūtaviṣayomagadhomāgadhāyaca 31 tatrasūtyāṃsamutpannaḥ sūtonāmehajāyate endre satrepravṛttetugrahayuktebṛhaspatau 32 tameveṃdraṃ bārhaspatyetatrasūtovyajāyata śiṣyahastenayatpṛktamabhibhūtaṃgurorhaviḥ 33 adharottaradhāreṇajajñetadvarṇasaṃkaram yetrakṣatrātsamabhavanbrāhmaṇyāścaivayonitaḥ 34 pūrveṇaivatusādharmyādvaidharmāsteprakīrtitāḥ madhyamohyeṣasūtasyadharmaḥ kṣetropajīvinaḥ 35 purāṇeṣvadhikāromevihitobrāhmaṇairiha dṛṣṭvādharmamahaṃpṛṣṭobhavadbhirbrahmavādibhiḥ 36 tasmātsamyagbhuvibrūyāṃpurāṇamṛṣipūjitam pitṝṇāṃmānasīkanyāvāsavaṃsamapadyata 37 apadhyātācapitṛbhirmatsyagarbhebabhūvasā araṇīvahutāśasyanimittaṃpuṇyajanmanaḥ 38 tasyāṃbabhūvapūtātmāmaharṣistuparāśarāt tasmaibhagavatekṛtvānamaḥ satyāyavedhase 39 puruṣāyapurāṇāyabrahmavākyānuvartine mānavacchadmarūpāyaviṣṇaveśaṃsitātmane 40 jātamātraṃcayaṃvedaupatasthesasaṃgrahaḥ matimaṃthānamāvidhyayenāsauśrutisāgarāt 41 prakāśojanitolokemahābhāratacaṃdra māḥ bhārataṃbhānumānviṣṇuryadinasyuramītrayaḥ 42 tato'jñānatamaoṃdhasyakāvasthājagatobhavet kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃvyāsaṃviddhinārāyaṇaṃprabhum 43 kohyanyaḥ puṃḍarīkākṣānmahābhāratakṛdbhavet tasmādahamupāśrauṣaṃpurāṇaṃbrahmavādinaḥ 44 sarvajñātsarvalokeṣupūjitāddīptatejasaḥ purāṇaṃsarvaśāstrāṇāṃprathamaṃbrahmaṇāsmṛtam 45 uttamaṃsarvalokānāṃsarvajñānopapādakam trivargasādhanaṃpuṇyaṃśatakoṭipravistaram 46 niḥśeṣeṣucalokeṣuvājirūpeṇakeśavaḥ brahmaṇastusamādeśādvedānāhṛtavānasau 47 aṃgānicaturovedānpurāṇanyāyavistaram asureṇākhilaṃśāstramapahṛtyātmasātkṛtam 48 matsyarūpeṇājahārakalpādāvudakārṇave aśeṣametadavadadudakāṃtargatovibhuḥ 49 śrutvājagādacamunīnprativedāṃścatarmukhaḥ pravṛttissarvaśāstrāṇāṃpurāṇasyābhavattadā 50 kālenāgrahaṇaṃdṛṣṭvāpurāṇasyatadāvibhuḥ vyāsarūpastadābrahmāsaṃgrahārthaṃyugeyuge 51 caturlakṣapramāṇenadvāparedvāparejagau tadāṣṭādaśadhākṛtvābhūlokesminprakāśitaṃ 52 adyāpidevalokeṣuśatakoṭipravistaram tadevātracaturlakṣaṃsaṃkṣepeṇaniveśitam 53 pravakṣyāmimahāpuṇyaṃpurāṇaṃpādmasañjñitam sahasraṃpañcapañcāśatpaṃcakhaṇḍaissamanvitam 54 tatrādausṛṣṭikhaṇḍaṃsyādbhūmikhaṇḍaṃtataḥparam svargakhaṇḍaṃtataḥ paścāttataḥ pātālakhaṇḍakam 55 pañcamaṃcatataḥ khyātamuttaraṃkhaṇḍamuttamam etadevamahāpadmamudbhūtaṃyanmayaṃjagat 56 tadvṛttāntāśrayaṃyasmātpādmamityucyatetataḥ etatpurāṇamamalaṃviṣṇumāhātmyanirmalam 57 devadevohariryadvaibrahmaṇeproktavānpurā brahmaṇābhihitaṃpūrvaṃyāvanmātraṃmarīcaye 58 etadevacavaibrahmāpādmaṃlokejagādavai sarvabhūtāśrayaṃtaccapādmamityucyatebudhaiḥ 59 pādmaṃtatpaṃcapaṃcāśatsahasrāṇīhapaṭhyate paṃcabhiḥparvabhiḥproktaṃsaṃkṣepādvyāsakāritāt 60 pauṣkaraṃprathamaṃparvayatrotpannaḥ svayaṃvirāṭ dvitīyaṃtīrthaparvasyātsarvagrahagaṇāśrayam 61 tṛtīyaparvagrahaṇārājānobhūridakṣiṇāḥ vaṃśānucaritaṃcaivacaturtheparikīrtitam 62 paṃcamemokṣatatvaṃcasarvatatvaṃnigadyate pauṣkarenavadhāsṛṣṭiḥ sarveṣāṃbrahmakāritā 63 devatānāṃmunīnāṃcapitṛsargastathāparaḥ dvitīyeparvatāścaivadvīpāḥ saptasasāgarāḥ 64 tṛtīyerudra sargastudakṣaśāpastathaivaca caturthesaṃbhavorājñāṃsarvavaṃśānukīrttanam 65 antyepavargasaṃsthānaṃmokṣaśāstrānukīrttanam sarvametatpurāṇe'smitkathayiṣyāmivodvijāḥ 66 idaṃpavitraṃyaśasonidhānamidaṃpitṝṇāmativallabhaṃsyāt idaṃcadevasyasukhāyanityamidaṃmahāpātakabhiccapuṃsām 67 iti śrīpadmapurāṇeprathamesṛṣṭikhaṃḍepurāṇāvatāreprathamo'dhyāyaḥ 1
dvitīyo'dhyāyaṃ
sūtauvāca namasyesarvalokānāṃviśvasyajagataḥpatim yaimaṃkurutebhāvaṃsṛṣṭirūpaṃpradhānavit 1 lokakṛllokatatvajñoyogamāsthāyayogavit asṛjatsarvabhūtānisthāvarāṇicarāṇi ca 2 tamajaṃviśvakarmāṇaṃcitpatiṃlokasākṣiṇam purāṇākhyānajijñāsurvrajāmiśaraṇaṃvibhum 3 brahmaviṣṇugirīśebhyonamaskṛtvāsamāhitaḥ iṃdrā yalokapālebhyaḥ savitrecasamādhinā 4 munīnāṃcavariṣṭhāyavasiṣṭhāyamahātmane tadvaktre bhātatapasejātūkarṇyāyacākṣuṣe 5 tasmaibhagavatenatvāvedavyāsāyavedhase puruṣāyapurāṇāyabhṛguvākyānuvartine 6 tasmādahamupāśrauṣaṃpurāṇaṃbrahmavādinaḥ sarvajñātsarvalokeṣupūjitāddīptatejasaḥ 7 avyaktaṃkāraṇaṃyattannityaṃsadasadātmakam mahadādiviśeṣāṃtaṃsṛjatītiviniścayaḥ 8 aṇḍehiraṇmayepūrvaṃbrahmaṇaḥ sūtiruttamā aṃḍasyāvaraṇaṃcādbhirapāmapicatejasā 9 vāyunātasyavāyoḥ khāttadbhūtāditaāvṛtam bhūtādirmahatācāpiavyaktenāvṛtomahān 10 prādurbhāvaścalokānāmaṃḍaevopavarṇitaḥ nadīnāṃparvatānāṃcaprādurbhāvonuvarṇyate 11 manvaṃtarāṇāṃsaṃkṣepātkalpānāṃcopavarṇanam brahmavṛkṣalayabrahmaprajāsargopavarṇanam 12 kalpānāṃsaṃcaraścaivajagataḥsthāpanaṃtathā śayanaṃcaharerapsupṛthivyuddharaṇaṃpunaḥ 13 daśadhājanmasaṃcārobhṛguśāpenakeśave sanniveśoyugādīnāṃsarvāśramavibhājanam 14 svargasthānavibhāgaścamartyānāṃsvargacāriṇāṃ paśūnāṃpakṣiṇāṃcaivasaṃbhavaḥ parikīrttitaḥ 15 tathānirvacanaṃkalpaṃsvādhyāyasyaparigrahaḥ pratisargāḥ punaḥ proktābrahmaṇobuddhipūrvakāḥ 16 trayonye'buddhipūrvāstetathālokānakalpayat brahmaṇovadanebhyaścabhṛgvādīnāṃsamudbhavaḥ 17 kalpayoraṃtaraṃproktaṃpratisaṃdhiścasargayoḥ bhṛgvādīnāmṛṣīṇāṃcaprajāsargopavarṇanam 18 vasiṣṭhasyacabrahmarṣerbrahmattvaṃparikīrttitam svāyaṃbhuvasyacamanostataścāpyanukīrtanam 19 uktonābhervisargaścarajasaścamahātmanaḥ dvīpānāṃcasamudrā ṇāṃparvatānāṃcakīrtanam 20 dvīpabhedasamudrā ṇāmantarbhāvaścasaptasu kīrtyanteyojanāgreṇayecatatranivāsinaḥ 21 tadīyānicavarṣāṇinadībhiḥparvataiḥsaha jaṃbūdvīpādayodvīpāḥsamudrai saḥptabhirvṛtāḥ 22 aṃḍasyāṃtastvimelokāḥ saptadvīpācamedinī sūryācaṃdra masoścārograhāṇāṃ jyotiṣāṃtathā 23 kīrtyatedhruvasāmarthyātprajānāṃcaśubhāśubham brahmaṇānirmitaḥsauraḥ syaṃdanorthavaśātsvayam 24 kalpito bhagavāṃstenaprasarpatidivākaraḥ sūryādīnāṃsyaṃdanānāṃdhruvādevapravarttanaṃ 25 kalpitaḥśiṃśumāraścayasyapucchedhruvaḥsthitaḥ saṃbhavāṃtecasaṃhāraḥ saṃhārāṃtecasaṃbhavaḥ 26 devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃcamanoḥpitṛgaṇasyaca naśakyaṃvistarādvaktumityuktaṃcasamāsataḥ 27 atītānāgatānāṃvaisamaṃsvāyaṃbhuvenatu manvaṃtareṣudevānāṃprajeśānāṃcakīrtanam 28 naimittikaḥprākṛtikastathaivātyaṃtikaḥ smṛtaḥ trividhaḥsarvabhūtānāṃkalpitaḥpratisaṃcaraḥ 29 anāvṛṣṭirbhāskarāccaghoraḥ saṃvarttakānalaḥ meghāścaikārṇavāyetutathārātrirmahātmanaḥ 30 saṃdhyālakṣaṇamuddiṣṭaṃtathābrāhmaṃviśeṣataḥ bhūtānāṃcāpilokānāṃsaptānāmanuvarṇanam 31 saṃkīrtyaṃtemayācātrapāpānāṃrauravādayaḥ sarveṣāmevasatvānāṃpariṇāmavinirṇayaḥ 32 brahmaṇaḥpratisargaścasarvasaṃhāravarṇanam kalpekalpecabhūtānāṃmahatāmapisaṃkṣayaḥ 33 susaṃkhyāyacabuddhvāvaibrahmaṇaścāpyanityatām daurātmyaṃcaivabhogānāṃsaṃsārasyacakaṣṭatām 34 durllabhatvaṃcamokṣasyavairāgyāddoṣadarśanam vyaktāvyaktaṃparityajya satvaṃbrahmaṇisaṃsthitam 35 nānātvadarśanātsusthastatastadabhivarttate tatastāpatrayātītovirūpākhyoniraṃjanaḥ 36 ānaṃdaṃbrahmaṇaḥprāptonabibhetikutaścana itikṛtyasamuddeśaḥ pramāṇasyopavarṇitaḥ 37 kīrtyaṃtejagatoyatrasargapralayavikriyāḥ pravṛttiścāpibhūtānāṃnivṛttīnāṃphalānica 38 prādurbhāvovasiṣṭhasyaśakterjanmatathaivaca saudāsānnigrahastasyaviśvāmitrakṛtenaca 39 parāśarasyacotpattiradṛśyantyāṃyathāvibhoḥ jajñepitṝṇāṃkanyāyāṃvyāsaścāpiyathāmuniḥ 40 śukasyacayathājanmaputrasyasahadhīmataḥ parāśarasyavidveṣoviśvāmitrakṛtoyathā 41 vasiṣṭhasaṃbhṛtaścāgnirviśvāmitrajighāṃsayā saṃdhānahetorvibhunājīrṇaḥkaṇvenadhīmatā 42 devenaviprāviprāṇāṃviśvāmitrahitaiṣiṇā ekaṃvedaṃcatuḥpādaṃcaturdhāpunarīśvaraḥ 43 yathābibhedabhagavānavyāsaḥ sarveṣvanugrahāt tasyaśiṣyapraśiṣyaiścaśākhābhedāḥ punaḥ kṛtāḥ 44 prayāgemunivaryaiścayathāpṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃprabhuḥ kṛṣṇenacānuśiṣṭāste munayodharmakāṃkṣiṇaḥ 45 etatsarvaṃyathātatvamākhyātaṃdvijasattamāḥ munīnāṃdharmanityānāṃlokataṃtramanuttamam 46 brahmaṇāyatpurāproktaṃ pulastyāyamahātmane pulastyenāthabhīṣmāyagaṃgādvāreprabhāṣitam 47 dhanyaṃyaśasyamāyuṣyaṃsarvvapāpapraṇāśanam kīrtanaṃśravaṇaṃcāsyadhāraṇaṃcaviśeṣataḥ 48 sūtenānukrameṇedaṃpurāṇaṃsaṃprakāśitam brāhmaṇeṣupurāyaccabrahmaṇoktaṃsavistaram 49 pādamasyavidansamyagyodhīyītajitedri yaḥ tenādhītaṃpurāṇaṃsyātsarvaṃnāstyatrasaṃśayaḥ 50 yovidyāccaturovedānsāṃgopaniṣadodvijaḥ purāṇaṃcavijānātiyaḥ satasmādvicakṣaṇaḥ 51 itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃvedaṃsamupabṛṃhayet bibhetyalpaśrutādvedomāmayaṃpratariṣyati 52 adhītyacaikamadhyāyaṃsvayaṃproktaṃsvayaṃbhuvā āpadaḥprāpyamucyetayatheṣṭāṃprāpnuyādgatim 53 purāparaṃparāṃvaktipurāṇaṃtenavaismṛtam niruktimasyayovedasarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate 54 ṛṣayohyabruvansūtaṃkathaṃbhīṣmeṇasaṅgataḥ brahmaṇomānasaḥputraḥ pulastyobhagavānṛṣiḥ 55 durlabhaṃdarśanaṃyasyanaraiḥ pāpasamanvitaiḥ atyāścaryamidaṃsūtakṣatriyeṇakathaṃmuniḥ 56 ārādhitobṛhadbhūtastannovadamahāmate kīdṛśaṃvātapastenakovānyoniyamaḥ kṛtaḥ 57 yenatuṣṭomunirbrāhmastathātenaprabhāṣitaḥ parvavāpyathaparvārdhaṃsamagraṃvāprabhāṣitam 58 yasminsthāneyathādṛṣṭaḥpulastyobhagavānṛṣiḥ tannovadamahābhāgakalyāḥ smaśravaṇevayam 59 sūtauvāca yatragaṃgāmahābhāgāsādhūnāṃhitakāriṇī vibhidyaparvataṃvegānniḥsṛtālokapāvanī 60 gaṃgādvāremahātīrthebhīṣmaḥ pitṛparāyaṇaḥ śuśrūṣuḥsuciraṃkālaṃmahatāṃniyamesthitaḥ 61 yāvadvarṣaśataṃsāgraṃparameṇasamādhinā dhyāyamānaḥ paraṃbrahmatrikālaṃsnānamācarat 62 pitṝndevāṃstarpayataḥsvādhyāyenamahātmanaḥ ātmānaṃkarṣataścāsyatuṣṭodevaḥpitāmahaḥ 63 uvācatanayaṃbrahmāpulastyamṛṣisattamam satvaṃdevavrataṃbhīṣmaṃvīraṃkurukulodbhavam 64 tapasaḥsaṃnivarttasvakāraṇaṃcāsyakīrttaya pitṝnbhaktyāmahābhāgodhyāyamānassamāsthitaḥ 65 yohyasyamanasaḥkāmastaṃsaṃpādayamāciram pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvāpulastyomunisattamaḥ 66 gaṃgādvāramathāgatyabhīṣmaṃvacanamabravīt varaṃvarayabhadraṃ teyattemanasivarttate 67 tuṣṭastetapasāvīrasākṣāddevaḥpitāmahaḥ brahmaṇāpreṣitastehaṃvarāndāsyāmikāṃkṣitān 68 bhīṣmopitadvacaḥśrutvāmanaḥśrotrasukhāvaham unmīlyanayanedṛṣṭvāpulastyaṃpurataḥ sthitam 69 aṣṭāṃgapraṇipātenanatvātaṃmunisattamam uvācapraṇatobhūtvāsarvāṃgāligitāvaniḥ 70
